# ajwoo photo — agent guide

ajwoo photo is a browser photo editor at https://photo.ajwoo.com. People use the interface; agents use
`window.ajwooPhoto` in the same page (for example through a browser-automation tool). Both write the same
edit operations, so every agent change shows up in history and the person can undo it.

Everything runs in the browser. The original file is never modified or uploaded. Edits are a recipe that is
re-rendered from the original, so values are absolute and repeatable.

## Quick start

```js
const api = window.ajwooPhoto;
await api.openImage(fileOrBlobOrUrl, 'beach.jpg');   // URL must be same-origin or CORS-enabled
api.analyze();                                        // histogram, clipping %, mean/median luminance, warmth
const { ops } = api.suggest('auto');                  // proposed auto tone + white balance (not applied)
api.applyEdits({ ops, label: 'Auto' });
api.applyEdits({
  label: 'Darken sky',
  ops: [
    { op: 'addMask', id: 'sky', shape: { type: 'linear', from: [0.5, 0.0], to: [0.5, 0.45] },
      adjust: { 'light.exposure': -0.6, 'color.temperature': -15 } },
  ],
});
const preview = await api.renderPreview({ maxEdge: 768 });        // JPEG data URL to check your work
const before = await api.renderPreview({ compare: 'original' });
const file = await api.export({ format: 'jpeg', quality: 0.92 }); // { blob, name, width, height, ... }
```

## Methods

- `describeControls(group?)` — every control: id, label, group, min, max, default, step, unit, maskable, meaning.
- `openImage(source, name?)` — Blob/File or URL. Returns size and stats.
- `getState()` — photo info, revision number, changed values, masks, and history (author: You or Agent).
- `getRecipe()` — the full recipe JSON.
- `analyze(region?)` — measured on a small render of the current edit. `region` is {x, y, w, h} in 0–1 of the output.
- `applyEdits({ ops, label?, expectedRevision? })` — one history entry. If any op is invalid, nothing is applied and
  every error is listed. Values are never silently clamped. Pass `expectedRevision` (from getState) to avoid
  overwriting a newer human edit.
- `suggest('auto')` — proposed ops; apply them yourself.
- `renderPreview({ maxEdge?, compare?: 'original', overlay?: maskId })` — JPEG data URL (max 2048 px).
- `undo()`, `redo()`
- `export({ format?: 'jpeg' | 'png' | 'webp', quality?: 0–1, maxEdge? })` — full-resolution file. Up to 16.7 MP in this
  version. Metadata (including location) is not written.

## Ops

- `{ op: 'set', control, value, target? }` — absolute. `target` is 'global' (default) or a mask id.
- `{ op: 'adjust', control, delta, target? }` — relative; the response reports the resulting value.
- `{ op: 'setCurve', channel: 'rgb' | 'r' | 'g' | 'b', points: [[x, y], ...] }` — 2–16 points in 0–1.
- `{ op: 'setGeometry', rotate?: 0–3 quarter turns clockwise, flipH?, crop?: { x, y, w, h } }` — crop is in 0–1 of the rotated image.
- `{ op: 'addMask', id?, name?, shape, invert?, amount?: 0–100, adjust?: { controlId: value } }` — up to 4 masks.
  - `{ type: 'linear', from: [x, y], to: [x, y] }` — full effect at `from`, none at `to`.
  - `{ type: 'radial', center: [x, y], radius: [rx, ry], feather: 0–1 }` — radius in fractions of width and height.
  - `{ type: 'brush' }` — then paint with `paintBrush`.
- `{ op: 'updateMask', id, shape?, invert?, amount?, name? }`, `{ op: 'removeMask', id }`
- `{ op: 'paintBrush', mask, strokes: [{ points: [[x, y], ...], size, feather?, erase? }] }` — size is the brush
  diameter as a fraction of the photo's longer edge.
- `{ op: 'reset', scope?: 'all' | 'adjustments' | 'geometry' }`

Mask positions are normalized 0–1 in the original photo (after camera orientation, before crop and rotation),
so cropping never moves a mask.

Maskable controls: light.exposure, light.contrast, light.highlights, light.shadows, color.temperature, color.tint,
color.saturation, effects.clarity.

## Not yet available

Select subject / sky, healing and object removal, noise reduction, RAW, HEIC/TIFF outside Safari, PDF, zoom to 100%.
